mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts indicates increased demand for housing, which can lead to higher economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 2.5% signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, which can lead to higher economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising payroll employment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates increased economic activity, which can lead to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in GDP indicates increased economic activity, which can lead to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. However, this effect is only significant when the unemployment rate is below 5%.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of low unemployment and rising GDP are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in the consumer price index indicate an easing monetary cycle and rising inflation expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing cycle with rising inflation
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods with rising inflation are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate below 4.5% indicates a tight labor market, which can lead to higher wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts and a decrease in retail sales indicate decreased demand, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of low demand are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
